Plant icons
The 31 SVGs in plants/ are original illustrations created for this project.

Decoration icons
These original SVG illustrations were created for this project and are used by
the garden builder:
bench.svg, blossom.svg, deciduous-tree.svg, fence.svg, flower-pot.svg, flower.svg,
garden-arch.svg, garden-light.svg, pathway.svg, stepping-stones.svg,
water-feature.svg.

The following additional decoration SVGs remain from Twemoji and are not used by
the garden builder:
four-leaf-clover.svg, potted-plant.svg, rose.svg, seedling.svg, sunflower.svg,
tulip.svg.
